title: [docs] Fix typo in slice vs operation example
bug_description:
### 📚 The doc issue

https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/notes/numerical_accuracy.html#batched-computations-or-slice-computations

In the randomness note, the example comparing A.sum(-1)[0] with **A[:,0].sum()** seems incorrect, since these are not mathematically identical operations. Is the intended comparison between A.sum(-1)[0] and **A[0,:].sum()**?

### Suggest a potential alternative/fix

Change `A[:,0].sum()` to `A[0,:].sum()`

cc @svekars @sekyondaMeta @AlannaBurke
